about_short_description.short_description: Stack Auth is an open-source platform for authentication and user managemen built for developers.

product.name: Stack Auth Open-Source Authentication Platform
product.description: An open-source platform providing authentication and user management tools for developers, including components and APIs for login, user sessions, and account management.

product.name: Organizations & Teams Management
product.description: Tools to manage B2B customers with organizations and teams, including email invitations, team components, and administrative management features.

product.name: Permissions & Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
product.description: A system to define custom permission trees and organization-wide roles for managing user access and authorization.

product.name: Third-Party OAuth Integration
product.description: Integration with third-party OAuth providers like Gmail and OneDrive, handling OAuth flows and token refresh automatically.

product.name: Pre-Built Authentication UI Components
product.description: Styled React components for authentication features like password login, single sign-on (SSO), and two-factor authentication (2FA) to accelerate development.

product.name: User Impersonation
product.description: A feature that allows administrators to impersonate users for debugging or customer support purposes.
